importar.title: Import HR spreadsheet
importar.help: Choose the spreadsheet (.xlsx) with the sheets Dependencias, Puestos, Personas, Asignaciones and Delegaciones. It is checked first: you see what would be created or changed and the errors row by row, and nothing is saved. With no errors, everything is imported at once. Importing the same spreadsheet again duplicates nothing.
importar.errors_one: {{count}} error: fix it in the spreadsheet and check it again
importar.errors_other: {{count}} errors: fix them in the spreadsheet and check it again
importar.readyToApply: No errors: it can be imported.
importar.error: The spreadsheet could not be processed
